title: A Smoggy Jog and the Decision to Make Fewer Videos
titleZh: 雾霾慢跑与少拍视频的决定
description: Back in Beijing the day before returning to work, Steven runs through heavy smog, talks about heavy squats, his doubts about creatine and his caffeine rules, and takes an honest look at his weak video numbers and Xiaohongshu shadow bans. He also covers progress on his AI-powered language-learning project and three Chinese stocks he's watching after the National Day holiday.

sentences.zh: 本期速览
sentences.en: This episode at a glance

sentences.zh: 明天就要正式上班了，史蒂文在雾霾里慢跑了一圈，回来录了这期节目。
sentences.en: Steven starts work officially tomorrow. He went for a jog in the smog, then came back and recorded this episode.

sentences.zh: 他聊了健身、肌酸和咖啡因，坦白地盘点了视频数据，分享了AI项目的小突破，最后看了看国庆后的三只中国股票。
sentences.en: He talked about fitness, creatine and caffeine, gave an honest rundown of his video stats, shared a small breakthrough in his AI project, and finally looked at three Chinese stocks after the National Day holiday.

sentences.zh: 重返工作、新滤芯和雾霾里的跑步
sentences.en: Back to work, a new filter, and running in the smog

sentences.zh: 从周五开始，史蒂文应该能拿回护照，然后一口气工作三个月，一直干到一月中旬、春节之前。
sentences.en: Starting Friday, Steven should be able to get his passport back, and then work three months straight, all the way to mid-January, before the Spring Festival.

sentences.zh: 九月中旬回国后，他只上了五节课就放了国庆假，不过工资提前到账了。
sentences.en: After returning to China in mid-September, he taught only five classes before the National Day holiday began, but his salary arrived early.

sentences.zh: 他用这笔钱换了小米空气净化器的滤芯，怀疑最近呼吸不顺，就是旧滤芯惹的祸。
sentences.en: He used the money to replace the filter in his Xiaomi air purifier, suspecting that the old filter was to blame for his recent breathing trouble.

sentences.zh: 今天北京的空气质量指数一开始是162，后来降到154，显示为红色，属于“不健康”。
sentences.en: Today Beijing's air quality index started at 162, then dropped to 154, showing red, which counts as "unhealthy."

sentences.zh: 可史蒂文还是出门跑步了，理由有点站不住脚：“抽烟的人都还在跑步，雾霾里跑一跑能有多糟？”
sentences.en: But Steven still went out for a run, with a rather flimsy excuse: "Smokers still go running, so how bad can a run in the smog be?"

sentences.zh: 他想起2016、2017年左右，北京一家精酿酒吧卖过一款“空气末日”啤酒：空气质量指数每高100，酒就便宜10块钱。
sentences.en: He remembered that around 2016 or 2017, a craft beer bar in Beijing sold an "Airpocalypse" beer: for every 100 points the air quality index rose, the beer got 10 yuan cheaper.

sentences.zh: 他跑了7.02公里，用了51分16秒，平均每公里大约7分钟，比平时的6分30秒慢了不少。
sentences.en: He ran 7.02 kilometers in 51 minutes 16 seconds, averaging about 7 minutes per kilometer, quite a bit slower than his usual 6:30.

sentences.zh: 健身卡、大重量深蹲和新尝试
sentences.en: Gym card, heavy squats and new things to try

sentences.zh: 史蒂文的健身卡还剩三次，得在10月16日前用完。
sentences.en: Steven has three visits left on his gym card, and he has to use them before October 16.

sentences.zh: 这张卡15次大约290块钱。
sentences.en: The card costs about 290 yuan for 15 visits.

sentences.zh: 他住的小区里还有一家小健身房，一个月500块，一个季度800块。
sentences.en: There's also a small gym in his residential complex: 500 yuan a month, or 800 yuan a quarter.

sentences.zh: 附近别的健身房又贵又爱推销，可他只想要“一个能扔杠铃的地方”。
sentences.en: Other gyms nearby are expensive and love to hard-sell, but all he wants is "a place where he can drop a barbell."

sentences.zh: 他是从2024年9月才开始认真练力量的，以前主要是跑步、徒手训练和在家甩壶铃。
sentences.en: He only started training strength seriously in September 2024; before that it was mainly running, bodyweight training and swinging kettlebells at home.

sentences.zh: 昨天他深蹲了80公斤，还做了三件新鲜事：组间拉伸、每组之间休息90秒左右，不再急着做超级组，还用手机给自己录像，代替教练。
sentences.en: Yesterday he squatted 80 kg and also did three new things: stretching between sets, resting about 90 seconds between each set instead of rushing into supersets, and filming himself with his phone in place of a coach.

sentences.zh: 看了录像他才发现，自己并没有蹲到底，这也是他平时只用60公斤的原因。
sentences.en: Only after watching the video did he realize he wasn't actually squatting all the way down, which is also why he usually only uses 60 kg.

sentences.zh: 他想过请教练，但舍不得花钱。
sentences.en: He has thought about hiring a coach, but can't bring himself to spend the money.

sentences.zh: 腿这么酸，硬拉恐怕得等到周末了。
sentences.en: His legs are so sore that deadlifts will probably have to wait until the weekend.

sentences.zh: 对肌酸的疑虑和咖啡因规矩
sentences.en: Doubts about creatine and caffeine rules

sentences.zh: 史蒂文买了一罐100克的肌酸，每天只需要3到5克，但他一直没开始吃。
sentences.en: Steven bought a 100-gram tub of creatine. He only needs 3 to 5 grams a day, but he still hasn't started taking it.

sentences.zh: 他并不反对肌酸，只是不想依赖一种会让肌肉“充水”的东西，一停下来就“瘪了”。
sentences.en: He isn't against creatine. He just doesn't want to depend on something that makes his muscles "fill with water" and then "deflate" as soon as he stops.

sentences.zh: 他更喜欢吃天然食物，再加上豌豆蛋白粉，虽然光靠吃饭很难吃够蛋白质。
sentences.en: He prefers eating natural foods, plus pea protein powder, although it's hard to get enough protein from meals alone.

sentences.zh: 再说，他也不打算“硬拉小汽车”。
sentences.en: Besides, he isn't planning to "deadlift a small car" anyway.

sentences.zh: 他从网上学到两条咖啡因规矩，亲测有效：下午两三点以后不再碰咖啡因；早上起床后等90分钟再喝第一杯咖啡。
sentences.en: He learned two caffeine rules online and has tested them himself — they work: no caffeine after 2 or 3 p.m., and wait 90 minutes after getting up before the first cup of coffee.

sentences.zh: 视频数据和小红书“限流”
sentences.en: Video stats and Xiaohongshu "throttling"

sentences.zh: 他去多伦多办签证一路拍的视频正在陆续上线。
sentences.en: The videos he filmed along the way while going to Toronto for his visa are gradually going online.

sentences.zh: 短视频《护照真的必要吗？
sentences.en: The short video "Is a Passport Really Necessary?

sentences.zh: 》大约有1800次观看，只赚了48美分左右。
sentences.en: " has about 1,800 views and earned only around 48 cents.

sentences.zh: 昨天发布的《中国签证申请》只有50次观看、五个赞和一条评论：“欢迎光临”。
sentences.en: "Chinese Visa Application," posted yesterday, has only 50 views, five likes and one comment: "Welcome."

sentences.zh: 他自嘲道：“大家根本不在乎。”
sentences.en: He joked at his own expense: "Nobody cares at all."

sentences.zh: 今天的短视频叫《换个邮编，换套规矩》，讨论在加拿大抽大麻、再去中国工作行不行。
sentences.en: Today's short video is called "New Postal Code, New Rules," and discusses whether it's OK to smoke weed in Canada and then go work in China.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文说，小红书悄悄“限流”了他的两条视频：护照那条在小红书上是零播放，新加坡航班显示屏那条也被卡住了。
sentences.en: Steven said Xiaohongshu quietly "throttled" two of his videos: the passport one got zero plays on Xiaohongshu, and the one about the Singapore flight display screen was also stuck.

sentences.zh: 接下来还有几条视频：多伦多皇后西街（包括他边哭边吃“卡罗来纳死神”辣椒鸡胸肉）、冰球名人堂、尼亚加拉大瀑布和美国之行。
sentences.en: Several more videos are coming: Toronto's Queen Street West (including him crying while eating "Carolina Reaper" chili chicken breast), the Hockey Hall of Fame, Niagara Falls, and his trip to the US.

sentences.zh: 经验教训和下一步
sentences.en: Lessons learned and next steps

sentences.zh: 今年早些时候，他一路直播了东南亚、韩国、日本和台湾，可直播成本高，也不耐看。
sentences.en: Earlier this year he livestreamed his way through Southeast Asia, South Korea, Japan and Taiwan, but livestreaming is expensive and doesn't hold viewers' attention.

sentences.zh: 这次旅行尝试讲故事，但短视频卡在两千次左右，长视频只有一百次左右。
sentences.en: This trip he tried telling stories, but the short videos got stuck at around 2,000 views, and the long videos only got about 100.

sentences.zh: 想把旅行费用当成生意开销来抵税也行不通：如果连续三年左右都不赚钱，加拿大税务局会认为这只是“一个昂贵的爱好”。
sentences.en: Treating travel costs as business expenses to deduct from taxes won't work either: if you don't make money for about three years in a row, the Canada Revenue Agency will consider it just "an expensive hobby."

sentences.zh: 所以，下一步是少拍视频，也少发短视频。
sentences.en: So the next step is to make fewer videos and post fewer short videos too.

sentences.zh: 他打算把语言教学挪到另一个频道，甚至想给频道改个名字，比如“平民博主”。
sentences.en: He plans to move the language teaching to another channel, and is even thinking of renaming the channel, to something like "Commoner Blogger."

sentences.zh: 以后每个月认真策划一条视频，比如挑人最多的日子去王府井或三里屯，拍一条《这就是我宅在家的原因》。
sentences.en: From now on he'll carefully plan one video a month, for example going to Wangfujing or Sanlitun on the most crowded day to film "This Is Why I Stay Home."

sentences.zh: 不过他也承认，这么做有点“耍小聪明”。
sentences.en: But he also admits that doing this is a bit of a "cheap trick."

sentences.zh: AI的小胜利：总结、翻译和配音
sentences.en: Small wins with AI: summaries, translation and dubbing

sentences.zh: AI这边进展顺利。
sentences.en: Things are going well on the AI side.

sentences.zh: 他的剪辑流程现在能在Final Cut Pro里标出每一处剪辑。
sentences.en: His editing workflow can now mark every single cut in Final Cut Pro.

sentences.zh: 更大的项目是把每期节目变成语言学习材料：先写总结，再翻成中文和俄语，最后用AI配音。
sentences.en: The bigger project is turning each episode into language-learning material: first write a summary, then translate it into Chinese and Russian, and finally dub it with AI.

sentences.zh: 以前的版本东拼西凑，现在交给Claude Code就能一气呵成。
sentences.en: Earlier versions were cobbled together, but now he can hand it to Claude Code and get it done in one go.

sentences.zh: 女朋友听了昨天的中文音频，直接说“不对”：那个台湾口音的声音会在词语中间换气，有些声调也不对。
sentences.en: His girlfriend listened to yesterday's Chinese audio and said flatly, "That's not right": the Taiwanese-accented voice takes breaths in the middle of words, and some of the tones are off too.

sentences.zh: 所以这还算不上精品，但他的目标是做一个类似“Du Chinese”的网站，提供课文、词汇和语法点，内容全部来自这档播客。
sentences.en: So it's not a polished product yet, but his goal is to build a site like "Du Chinese" offering texts, vocabulary and grammar points, with all the content coming from this podcast.

sentences.zh: 国庆后的股市
sentences.en: The stock market after National Day

sentences.zh: 今天A股重新开盘，整体比较平淡。
sentences.en: Today the A-share market reopened, and overall it was fairly quiet.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文关注了三只股票（不构成投资建议，用他的话说：“你的钱，你的事”）：
sentences.en: Steven looked at three stocks (this isn't investment advice; in his words, "your money, your business"):

sentences.zh: 京东： 从25、26美元涨到27美元，过去一年三次跌到超卖区。
sentences.en: JD.com: rose from $25–26 to $27; in the past year it has dropped into oversold territory three times.

sentences.zh: 蔚来： 半年内股价腰斩，严重超卖，但上次超卖后反弹得很慢，说明不能只看RSI指标。
sentences.en: NIO: the share price has halved in six months and it's severely oversold, but after the last time it was oversold it rebounded very slowly, which shows you can't rely on the RSI indicator alone.

sentences.zh: 阿里巴巴： 七月从95美元左右反弹到120美元左右，现在在107美元附近，可能是个支撑位。
sentences.en: Alibaba: in July it rebounded from around $95 to around $120; it's now near $107, which may be a support level.

sentences.zh: 这三只股票都会加进节目备注里的追踪表格。
sentences.en: All three stocks will be added to the tracking spreadsheet in the show notes.

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's summary

sentences.zh: 史蒂文今天想说的是：跑步、健身、拍视频，都要坚持下去；但也要诚实地面对什么有用、什么没用，把时间和钱花在真正有回报的地方。
sentences.en: What Steven wanted to say today is: running, working out, and making videos all need to be kept up; but you also have to be honest about what works and what doesn't, and spend your time and money where it really pays off.

vocab.en: to be a bit too clever; to play tricks
